title: Fixed #37344 -- Enabled FETCH_PEERS batching for instances loaded by select_related.
body:
#### Trac ticket number

ticket-37344

#### Branch description

When using `select_related()` with `fetch_mode(FETCH_PEERS)`, `RelatedPopulator.populate()` did not initialize or attach `peers` to populated related model instances. As a result, subsequent relation or deferred field traversals on those joined instances could not batch queries across peers, degrading to N+1 single queries.

This change initializes and assigns `self.peers` on `RelatedPopulator` when `fetch_mode.track_peers` is active, adds regression tests for single-level, nested, and nullable `select_related` paths with deterministic ordering, and adds a Django 6.1.2 release note.

#### AI Assistance Disclosure (REQUIRED)
- [ ] **No AI tools were used** in preparing this PR.
- [x] **If AI tools were used**, I have disclosed which ones, and fully reviewed and verified their output.
OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) was used to assist in investigating the RelatedPopulator lifecycle, drafting the regression tests, and conducting an independent read-only code review. All code changes, tests, and diffs were reviewed and verified locally.
